description: budget.hit: a dimension's spend floor has reached its cap (or the cost is unproven and the unknown policy is stop) — the loop is about to park, or was just refused a start. The payload names the budget, the dimension, the floor that tripped it and the cap, with exact saying whether the floor was a total (P31: a floor with unknowns beside it is not one, and the stream says so rather than the reader guessing); loopId is present for the E1/E2 hits (a loop in flight) and absent for the E3 refused start (the loop does not exist yet, so the event rides the workspace root it was aimed at).
